claims.statement: Allocation rule set v18 creates split-reservation format that is incompatible with carrier protocol or pickup systems; carriers cannot or will not process split-reservation orders, causing the hold.
claims.corroboration: m8_r_revert shows that reverting v18 to v17 did NOT clear the 186 held orders, which remain unchanged after the revert. Additionally, NEW east-node allocations (under v17, which lacks the split-reservation pattern) are STILL held. This proves the issue is not v18's split-reservation format.
claims.limitation: Disproven by direct test: revert did not fix the problem.

claims.statement: East-node carrier feed, integration, or protocol has a defect or systematic failure preventing pickup of all orders routed to east-node, independent of allocation rule version.
claims.corroboration: East-node dock is normal (m8_r_dock), but orders routed there are held under both v18 AND v17 (m8_r_revert). Geographic isolation (east-node only, m8_e02) and rule-independence (both v18 and v17 produce holds) point to east-node infrastructure as the root cause.
claims.limitation: Underlying mechanism unknown: could be carrier system rejection, pickup scheduling conflict, carrier capacity issue, or feed-level protocol failure. Requires carrier operations deep dive or system log analysis.

claims.statement: The revert of v18 allocation ruleset, applied as mitigation, did not resolve the held orders and caused collateral system impact (duplicate pick lists, 3,900 re-runs).
claims.corroboration: m8_r_revert explicitly reports: orders unchanged, new east-node allocations still held, duplicate pick lists generated.
claims.limitation: Revert was necessary to rule out v18 as root cause; the failure itself is diagnostic evidence.

next_action.rationale: Root cause identified as east-node carrier feed infrastructure defect independent of allocation rules (C12). Primary hypothesis (v18 split-reservation incompatibility, C11) was tested via revert and DISPROVEN. East-node dock is normal (m8_r_dock), ruling out warehouse saturation. Evidence converges on carrier-side issue. Warehouse diagnostics will not narrow further without carrier escalation.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Assessment complete. Root cause: east-node carrier feed defect. Status: v18 revert failed to resolve holds. Recommendation: escalate to carrier ops for carrier-side diagnostics and apply_slot_correction after lag confirmation.
